reviews.title: They still charge you when you cancel the subscription
reviews.text:
Addition to my review: they never returned my money. Because you subscribe through app and you subscribe to web subscription. This is a scamming scheme which works really well. Because they then tell you "you subscribed to web not to app and that's why we charge you". Ehhh. So many people have lost so much money.

I gave bought only one reading for a few euros in December. Then i immediately cancelled my subscription on apple and the i have deleted (!) the app from my phone!. And only today i have spotted that they still charge me 22,8eur every week! Not a reminder - nothing. I have written an email to their support address. I hope they will return my money. I have never had a situation like that. It's absurd.
reviews.reply: Hello dear [Name]! Your feedback is the best way to improve our service, so we greatly appreciate it. Please accept our deepest sympathies for the troubles that you had with our product and for the payment problems as well. It seems there might be some confusion regarding our services. Our web service and mobile application are separate platforms, each requiring its own subscription. It's possible that you had an active subscription for both the web service and the mobile app. Cancelling the subscription on one platform does not automatically cancel the subscription on the other. We are happy to help you out if you have any more questions. You can contact us at any time by visiting nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and we'll try our best to respond to your inquiries right away! Best wishes, Nebula team 🔮

reviews.reply: Dear, thank you for your feedback, and please accept our apologies for any inconvenience caused. All information about managing and canceling your subscription was provided during the registration process and sent via email. For further assistance, please contact us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and we’ll be happy to help. Warm regards Nebula Support Team.

reviews.title: sadness
reviews.text: I canceled the app at free day and deleted the app on my iphone, they still charged me for one week 10€ . Have no app and no money. Never trying free trials ! And app is lame , you can get more clear information in astro.com reports which is daily free .
